structuredContent.scoreRationale: The score is set by the most severe finding (high); 4 findings (1 high, 3 medium) count toward it.
structuredContent.summary: The contract sets a fixed monthly service fee of 1,850,000.00 TL plus VAT, adjusted annually by the previous year's inflation rate. The employer may unilaterally reduce the monthly fee by up to 20% for perceived service quality issues without recourse. The employer can terminate the contract at any time with 60 days' notice without paying compensation. The contractor must maintain a minimum of 64 personnel and bear all personnel-related liabilities, including accidents and compensation.

risks.title: Counterparty's unilateral termination right
risks.finding: The employer may terminate the contract unilaterally without cause and without compensation with sixty days' written notice.
risks.evidence: The employer may terminate the contract unilaterally without cause and without compensation with sixty days' written notice.
risks.quote: İşveren, sözleşmeyi gerekçe göstermeksizin ve tazminat ödemeksizin altmış gün önceden yazılı bildirimle feshedebilir.

risks.title: Penalty clause
risks.finding: The contract includes a penalty clause requiring the violating party to pay 2,000,000.00 TL for confidentiality breaches.
risks.evidence: The contract includes a penalty clause requiring the violating party to pay 2,000,000.00 TL for confidentiality breaches.
risks.quote: Gizlilik ihlâli hâlinde ihlâl eden taraf 2.000.000,00 TL cezai şart öder.

risks.title: Automatic renewal
risks.finding: The contract automatically renews for one year under the same conditions unless terminated in writing 180 days before expiration.
risks.evidence: The contract automatically renews for one year under the same conditions unless terminated in writing 180 days before expiration.
risks.quote: Sözleşme, süre bitiminden yüz seksen gün önce yazılı olarak feshedilmedikçe aynı şartlarla bir yıl uzar.

risks.title: Liability limitation or waiver
risks.finding: The employer's liability under this contract is limited to the total service fee of the last three months.
risks.evidence: The employer's liability under this contract is limited to the total service fee of the last three months.
risks.quote: İşverenin bu sözleşmeden doğan sorumluluğu, son üç aylık hizmet bedeli toplamını aşamaz.

risks.title: Employer's unilateral right to reduce service fee by up to 20% without dispute
risks.finding: The employer can reduce the contractor's monthly payment by up to 20% at their sole discretion without any right of objection, posing a significant financial risk to the contractor.
risks.evidence: Clause 2.3 states the employer can reduce the monthly fee by up to 20% for insufficient service quality, and 2.4 states this decision is at employer's discretion and not subject to objection.
risks.quote: İşveren, hizmet kalitesini yetersiz bulduğu ayda bedelin %20'sine kadar kesinti yapabilir.

risks.title: Contractor's obligation to maintain minimum 64 personnel and bear all related liabilities
risks.finding: The contractor must maintain a minimum of 64 personnel and is fully responsible for all personnel-related liabilities, which could result in significant cost and legal exposure.
risks.evidence: Clause 3.1 requires the contractor to maintain at least 64 personnel, and 3.3 states all work accident and compensation liabilities belong to the contractor.

recommendations: Negotiate to limit the employer's unilateral right to reduce payments or introduce a dispute resolution mechanism for such reductions.
Seek to include compensation or longer notice periods for contract termination by the employer to reduce operational risk.
Clarify and possibly limit the contractor's liability for personnel-related accidents and compensation to manage financial exposure.

keyMetrics.label: Annual fee increase based on previous year's inflation
Maximum monthly fee reduction by employer

advisorQuestions: Can the employer provide objective criteria or a process for determining service quality before applying fee reductions?
What protections or remedies exist for the contractor if the employer terminates the contract early?
Are there insurance or indemnity provisions covering personnel-related liabilities beyond the third-party liability insurance?
